text: The People’s Bank of China held its H2 2026 work meeting, saying resolution of key financial risks is continuing. Financial support for financing-platform debt risk mitigation has produced notable results and financial markets are running well. From a macroprudential perspective
text_zh: 中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议，表示重点金融风险处置工作持续推进。融资平台债务风险化解的金融支持取得明显成效，金融市场运行平稳。从宏观审慎角度出发——
